records.description: Bright and spacious newly remodeled studio w/ large backyard backyard with garden views, laundry available UNIT FEATURES: *Floor to ceiling glass door opening to a large patio creating an indoor/outdoor connection providing great natural light *Newly remodeled kitchen with stainless steel appliances *New wood laminate floors *Bathroom with tiles, tub, vanity, toilet, light fixture, mirror *Ample closet space and storage in unit *Electric baseboard heater *Individual water heater in unit *Unit is newly painted in a white color palette *Modern light fixtures *BUILDING FEATURES: *On-site management for deliveries and emergencies/repairs *Updated lobby with new floors, LED lights *Modern and spacious elevator *Laundry facility with card reader *Non smoking premises *Secured apartment complex with intercom system with remote access RENTAL DETAILS: *Unit is available from November 1, 2025 *One year lease then month to month thereafter *Security deposit: 1 month *Tenant pays for utilities, cable/internet *Non smoking *No pets LOCATION: *Convenient central location in Lower Nob Hill near Union Square, Financial District, Nob Hill/Soma *Walking distance to Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, neighborhood stores, restaurants and cafes, bars *Easy access to public transportation (Muni buses, tech shuttles) *Walkscore: 99 (Walker's Paradise) *Transit Score: 100 (Rider's Paradise) *Bike Score: 74 (Very Bikeable)
